items.title: Pay the claimed amount directly to the claimant (if claim accepted)
items.quote: Halten Sie die Forderung für berechtigt, begleichen Sie die Summe samt laufender Zinsen binnen zwei Wochen seit Zustellung dieses Bescheids direkt bei der Antragstellerin.
items.computation: The Zustellungsvermerk states formal personal delivery on 20.11.2026 ('übergeben am 20.11.2026 an den Empfänger persönlich'); this stated date is the delivery day, no days are added (formal delivery rule). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week period ends on the same weekday two weeks later. 20.11.2026 is a Friday, so the period ends Friday 04.12.2026. Since the last day is a working day (Friday, no public holiday in BY), no §193 BGB extension is needed. Due date: 04.12.2026.

items.title: Notify the Mahngericht of Widerspruch if the claim is disputed
items.quote: Bestreiten Sie sie ganz oder zum Teil, teilen Sie dem Mahngericht innerhalb derselben Frist mit, dass Sie Widerspruch erheben; verwenden Sie dafür möglichst den beigelegten Vordruck.
items.computation: Same two-week period as above, running from the formal personal delivery on 20.11.2026 (Friday), day of delivery not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB). Two weeks later, same weekday, is Friday 04.12.2026. This is a working day in Bayern (no public holiday), so the deadline is not shifted under §193 BGB. The Widerspruch must reach the Mahngericht by this date. Due date: 04.12.2026.

warnings: The letter is a Mahnbescheid: if neither payment nor a timely Widerspruch is made by the deadline, the claimant can obtain a Vollstreckungsbescheid and enforce the debt (e.g. by garnishing the bank account), as stated: 'Ohne Zahlung und ohne Widerspruch kann ein Vollstreckungsbescheid erlassen werden.'

Several names in the letter (Beispielcoburg, Beispielhuber, Beispielmünchen, Exempel Fitnesswell GmbH) look like placeholder/example names rather than real entities; if this is meant to be a genuine letter, double-check the actual sender and recipient names on the original document before relying on this analysis.

The court has not examined the underlying claim ('Das Gericht hat ihren Anspruch nicht geprüft'), so the recipient should verify independently whether the claimed membership fees and the returned-direct-debit fee (Rücklastschriftgebühren) are actually justified before paying.
